exchanges: finally sat down for the first time today, my feet are done
You have earned the rest. Busy day?
so busy. we had a catering order for 200 mini quiches. jun and i didnt stop once
That is a lot of quiches for two people.
tell me about it. ok i need to plan stuff, my brother sam's birthday is in August and i want to make him something big
That gives you some time. What does he like?
he likes anything chocolate. funny thing, jun's wife is also sam, short for samantha, and hers is in November so i get to bake for two sams this year
Two people named Sam, two cakes.
haha yes. ok also my wedding planning is eating my life
How is it going?
we booked Kortright for the reception, the conservation area with the big trees, so thats done at least
Getting the venue locked in is a big step.
my grandma rosa is the problem lol she has celiac so she cant have gluten and she wants to taste every cake option
That makes tasting harder. A cake she can eat would be a nice touch.
i'll do a flourless chocolate one for her table
That sounds like a good solution.
ok and then Churro, my dog, needs a walk, hes been stuck at home all day
Has he been waiting by the door?
he just stares at me until i give in
That stare is hard to resist.
lol so true. noor our barista asked for next week off for exams
Good luck to her. What are the exams for?
she's in second year nursing at the college, she wants to work in pediatrics
That is a demanding programme.
shes so smart. she makes the best flat whites too
Sounds like a great hire.
tariq the produce guy said hes from Lahore, we got talking about mangoes
That sounds like a fun chat.
he brought me some to try, so sweet
Fresh mangoes are hard to beat.
ok i'm on the couch now with Middlemarch, trying to read 20 pages before i pass out
That is a long book for tired eyes.
ya i'm like halfway after two months lol
No rush with a book like that.
oh wait i got that wrong, tariq is from Karachi not lahore, i mixed it up
Thanks for clarifying.
i keep picking up my ukulele instead of reading lol, i'm learning a new song for the wedding
That would be a sweet surprise.
only if i dont mess it up
Practice helps. How many weeks do you have?
a few. ok its getting late
Get some sleep soon.
in a sec. my ex henrik texted me out of nowhere
What did he say?
that hes moving to Copenhagen for a job and wanted to say bye, kind of weird but ok
That is a nice gesture, if a little out of the blue.
ok last thing, when is my brother's birthday again, i want to put it in my calendar
ok night
Good night, sleep well.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your brother Sam's birthday is in August.
